program Main

uses IO, Shop

function total(items: List[Item]): Integer
    var sum := 0
    for item in items do
        sum := sum + item.qty
    return sum

let i := Item(name: "a", qty: 2)
let named: Item := i
let sizes := [Size.Small, Size.Large]
for k, v in ["a": 1] do
    writeln("{k}{v}")
writeln(total([i, named]) + length(sizes))
let both := concat([3], [1])
let same := concat[Integer]([3], [1])
